budget_rationale: With N=50, standard NSGA-II requires ~50 unique wrapper evaluations at initialization and ~100 after one complete generation. The original N=12, G=6 confirmation used roughly 70-83 evaluations, so the original budget lies between these standard-generation brackets. A partial generation was deliberately not used because it would alter standard NSGA-II.
arcene_status: Not included in the formal P0-4 table: pop=50 ARCENE held-out Pareto-set evaluation at D=10000 exceeded the single-job execution window before a complete 10-seed paired table could be produced; no partial ARCENE rows are reported.
